answer_1.quote: We introduce TROVE, a new challenge that traces each target sentence to its originating sources and classifies fine-grained target-source relationships beyond coarse-grained or single-document source identification.
answer_1.outputs: The target text consists of multi-sentence outputs from tasks such as summarization and question answering, where each sentence is traced to source documents and their relationships classified.

answer_2.quote: We propose an evaluation method to assess model performance on this task... we introduce macro-average and micro-average metrics at the sentence level.

answer_3.quote: We use crafted prompts to guide GPT-4o in preliminary annotation, aiming to identify the sources of target sentences from retrieved candidate sentences and classify the target-source relationships...

answer_4.quote: Annotators review GPT-4o's results to verify the provenance sentences and their corresponding relationship types... We invite 8 graduate students to spend about 510 hours annotating the provenance of 4,388 English and 811 Chinese sentences...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators examine the document collections to address omissions and verify the provenance sentences and relationship types identified by GPT-4o.
